service.description: Run connection diagnostics against a saved connector config, using only the stored credentials. Dispatched off the SourceSystemConnector registry, so core names no connector. `ok` reports that the diagnostic ran; `connectionOk` reports the verdict.

parameter.name: stage
parameter.description: Run only this stage, as reported by a previous call's nextStage. Lets a caller render each check the moment the server finishes it.

parameter.name: staged
parameter.description: Start a staged run: with no stage, runs only the connector's first stage. Leave false (and stage blank) to run the whole probe in one call.

parameter.name: nextStage
parameter.description: Stage to pass back to continue a staged run, or blank when finished — either the probe completed or a failure made the remaining stages meaningless.
